votes.motion: Approve the Work Session and Formal meeting minutes from Tuesday, September 21, 2021.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session and formal meeting minutes from September 21, 2021.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-3 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on three grant applications (Salt Lake County Corridor Preservation Fund, Marathon Petroleum Foundation Thriving Communities YouthCity Transportation Solutions, and Mental Health First Responders) and referred them to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 2 of 2022, amending the FY 2021-22 final budget of Salt Lake City only for items as shown on the motion sheet, including I-3: Rescope FY22 CIP Funds for Tennis Improvements at a New Location from Wasatch Hills Tennis Center to Liberty Park Tennis Center ($400,000 in CIP Fund).
votes.description: The Council adopted Budget Amendment No. 5 for Fiscal Year 2021-22, which includes adjustments such as rescoping CIP funds for tennis improvements from Wasatch Hills Tennis Center to Liberty Park Tennis Center.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 1 of 2022, appointing Council Member Victoria Petro-Eschler to the Utah Inland Port Authority Board.
votes.description: The Council approved the appointment of Council Member Victoria Petro-Eschler to serve on the Utah Inland Port Authority Board.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 2 of 2022, Amending Resolution 31 of 2021 relating to the State Infrastructure Bank Loan.
votes.description: The Council amended a prior resolution to clarify that the UDOT State Infrastructure Bank loan to the City will be repaid from the City's Innkeepers Tax rather than sales tax revenue.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 3 of 2022, establishing the Salt Lake City Designated Water Service Area and approve the map that identifies the area.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance establishing the City's designated water service area, in response to a new requirement from Utah's 2020 constitutional amendment D.

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda (board appointments of Richard Nazzaro, Jenny Bonk, and Jacob Skog to the CDCIP Advisory Board).
votes.description: The Council approved three appointments to the Community Development and Capital Improvement Programs Advisory Board, each for a term ending June 2, 2025.
